bracket_representative_diagnostic.example: For k>=4,Xstar=x^2 partial_x+x^k partial_u and Xzero=x^k partial_u represent the same nonzero orbit symbol and have zero first jet; their brackets with partial_x+x partial_u differ by a nonzero order2 component.
bracket_representative_diagnostic.failure: Zero first derivative does not justify the claimed representative-independent bracket calculation or its asserted lower-order vanishing.
bracket_representative_diagnostic.sufficient_condition: The entire ordinary(k-1)-jet of the representative vanishes; full stabilizer lifting supplies this normalization.

spencer_section_construction.determining_equations: Finite-order homogeneous linear system with all ordinary prolongation equations through the indicated orders.
spencer_section_construction.regularity: Locally constant rank of A_(k-1) composed with transformation-jet truncation, on the equation (k-1)-jet base.
spencer_section_construction.normalization: The representing transformation jet has value zero and first derivative zero on the tangent plane; no zero entire lower ordinary jet required.
spencer_section_construction.construction: Extend the representing jet as a kernel section; take minus the horizontal Spencer difference. Its admissibility follows by subtracting a differentiated determining equation from the derivative of the section equation.
spencer_section_construction.representative_independence: The admissible transformation jet can depend on its extension; its prolonged action is the same intrinsic insertion, so differences lie in the lower stabilizer.
spencer_section_construction.image_lifting_corollary: Equality of adjacent first-derivative stabilizer images supplies the normalization. It is not full stabilizer lifting and does not validate the raw bracket.

pure_symbol_presentation.ordinary_symbol_hypothesis: Finite defining order with higher ordinary symbols given by algebraic prolongation.
pure_symbol_presentation.base: Integral affine chart of allowed tangent planes at one base point; nonzero first-jet parameter f inverted.
pure_symbol_presentation.construction: Finite homogeneous annihilator module; monic module elimination over the parameter fraction field; clear finitely many denominators from generators, representations and S-vector reduction identities.
pure_symbol_presentation.specialization: After this localization, the eliminated relation module specializes to the actual pure-action symbol annihilator in every degree and at every field-valued parameter.

scope_limits: The general application needs eventual regularity and first-derivative stabilizer-image equality on every higher-jet inverse image of one finite-level invariant open, or another contraction argument.

Horizontal rank, invariant derivations, symbol cohomology, affine orbit bundles and the generation induction are not proved by the symbol lemmas.

exact_results.scope: There is an order k1 such that the vertically reduced jet bundles have locally constant rank at every order k>=k1. The finite-jet version is over J_(k+1), not one common finite-level base.
For every fixed infinite jet X, there is an order l(X) beyond which the symbol contractions/prolongation inclusion hold, under the stated regularity hypothesis.
The eventual equality with algebraic prolongation likewise has an order k1(X) depending on X.
The localized regularity hypotheses and conclusion allow an open neighborhood of X_(k+1) that depends on k.

quantifier_comparison.cited_pointwise: For every X there exists l(X) such that for every k>=l(X), P(X,k).
quantifier_comparison.cited_local: For a fixed X and each sufficiently large k there is a neighborhood W_(k+1) of X_(k+1) on which the stated order-k property holds.
quantifier_comparison.required_uniform: There exist a finite l and a nonempty invariant Zariski open U in E^l such that P(a,k) holds for every k>=l and every compatible higher jet a above U.
